page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Marginal notes in the right margin, keyed to reference marks in the text. Left margin empty. Running head at top left, page number at top right. Gathering signature "Mm" at the foot.

main_text.p: {a}Aphthonium,Progymnasm. in ἥσ-[?] ποιίας. {b}Dionysium Longinum,De sublimi gen.orat. {c}Lucia-num,Dialog. mort. Diog. & Herc. {d}Eunapium,De vitis sophistar. in Æ-desio. {e}Synesium,De insomn. {f}Xiphilinum,Epit.Dion. in Tito & Severo. {g}Ni-cephorum Gregorium,Hist.lib.8. {h}Nicetam, & varios {i}Scho-liastas:In Euripidis Hecubam. Æschyli Persas, Sophoclis Aiacem, & Pindari Olymp.odyss.8. similitudo, quâ rationum, quâ sententiarum; quibus ostenderem εἴδωλον perinde ad imaginem quamvis, absque magni & parvi discrimine, no-tandum ab his adhibitum esse ac à superioribus vereor ne fastidium lectori excitaret.

4 Cui si minus certa inde videatur mea de Græ-corū omnium autorum consensu enunciatio, quòd nec Hesychius, nec Suidas, nec autor Etymologici, nec Glossarium vetus, nec {k}ManuelPræfat.in Euripid.Hecub. Moschopulus, nec Phavorinus Camers, nec (quoniam Henrici Stephani ThesaurusThesaur. or-thodox.fid.l. 2.c.8o. & lib. 4.hær.31. parum gratiosus est apud Bellarminum) Lexici Regiis Bibliis adiecti con-cinnator, unico, aut exemplo, aut verbo doceat contrarium: at probabitur, ipsero[?], ex confessione Molani, censoris Pōtificii; vel potius ex Valentiani Iesuitæ oraculo; vel saltem Bellarmini ipsius documentis, quibus veritatem, dum convellit, roborat. Nam ubi Hadriani Iunii Nomenclator observa-verat εἴδωλον idè[?] significare, non quòd imagúncula[?], {l}icuncula, sigillū, oscillū, εἰκόνιον, sive ἀγαλμάτιον,Cap. de instrumentis & suppellect. ecclesiast. sed quòd imago, icon, signū, sculptile, statua, simu-lacrū, εἶδος, ἄγαλμα, ξόανον, βρέτας, ἀνδριὰς, & εἶδος; Molanus ei capiti apposuit hanc censuram: Non male nomenclator imaginē, statuam, sculptile, simulacrum, idolum, & cetera pro isdem habet; meminerit tamen lector quadam usu Scripturæ & Scriptorum Ecclesiæ in malam partem capi. {m}Valentianus au-tem dicēs, Neque absurdè professiò putaveris, B. Petrum insinuauisse cultum aliquem simulacrorū (nempe sacrarum imaginum, rectum esse, quum fideles nominatim ab {n}illicitis idolorum cultibus deterrereDe idololatr. l.2.c.6.1.Pet.4.3..

page.notes: Printed note text in the right margin is partly worn; the Greek in note a ("ἥσ-[?]") and the Greek and Latin in note k are doubtful. Reference marks in the text and margin letters were matched by position where the printed margin notes do not sit beside their marks; the marks themselves are as printed. Doubtful readings: "ipsero", "idè", "imagúncula" (marked [?]). The Greek words εἴδωλον, εἰκόνιον, ἀγαλμάτιον, εἶδος, ἄγαλμα, ξόανον, βρέτας, ἀνδριὰς are copied as seen. Possible printing error: "Pōtificii" (macron as printed). Page number 543 and running head as printed.
